# MimOS boot menu.
#
# GRUB has no font fallback and cannot render an SVG. Every font and image named
# here is a real file installed beside this one, generated by
# scripts/generate-grub-theme.py from packages/mimos-branding/palette.json.
#
# Two rules this file exists to keep, both learned from a capture rather than
# from reading:
#
# 1. The background keeps its aspect ratio. A boot menu meets whatever
#    resolution the firmware gives it, and stretching the 16:9 artwork onto a
#    16:10 or 4:3 panel makes the embrace symbol visibly narrow. A stretched
#    logo is a wrong logo.
#
# 2. The card behind the menu is drawn by GRUB, not painted into the
#    background. The first version painted it into the artwork and positioned
#    the menu over it in absolute pixels; at 1280x800 the background scaled and
#    the menu did not, so the entries hung off the edge of a card that had
#    moved. Percentages here, and one rectangle instead of two.

title-text: ""
desktop-image: "background.png"
desktop-image-scale-method: "crop"
desktop-image-h-align: "center"
desktop-image-v-align: "center"
desktop-color: "#221B3A"
terminal-font: "Inter Regular 28"

+ boot_menu {
  left = 20%
  top = 38%
  width = 60%
  height = 50%

  menu_pixmap_style = "menu_*.png"

  item_font = "Inter Regular 28"
  item_color = "#F8F4FF"
  selected_item_color = "#FFFFFF"
  # item_height has to leave room for the highlight's own corners: GRUB will
  # not draw a box shorter than twice its corner slice, and a highlight that
  # grows past the row it belongs to covers the entry below it.
  # The highlight is drawn item_height tall PLUS its corner slice on each side,
  # so the distance between rows has to clear item_height + 2 * 16. Measured,
  # not assumed: at item_height 52 with a 28px corner the pill came out 106
  # tall against a 58px row pitch, and the entry below it was overlapped.
  item_height = 44
  item_spacing = 34
  # Zero, so the highlight runs the full width of the card instead of sitting
  # in a narrow strip inside it.
  item_padding = 0
  icon_width = 0
  icon_height = 0
  item_icon_space = 28

  selected_item_pixmap_style = "select_*.png"

  scrollbar = true
  scrollbar_width = 8
  scrollbar_thumb = "select_*.png"
}

# The countdown, so a machine that is waiting does not look like one that has
# stopped.
+ progress_bar {
  id = "__timeout__"
  # Below the card and above the hint. The boot_menu paints its card over
  # sibling components inside its rectangle, so the previous 79% position made
  # this valid component completely invisible on the installed menu even while
  # the timeout was running.
  left = 42%
  top = 92%
  width = 16%
  height = 6
  show_text = false
  bg_color = "#3A3058"
  fg_color = "#7452F5"
  border_color = "#3A3058"
}
